title: Find a Group of Some
short: Find the group that has a number of things.

blocks.html: Sometimes we need a group of some number. “Bring me 4 spoons!” Let’s find groups that have just the number we need.

blocks.name: pk-pic
blocks.cap: Which group has 4 stars? Tap it.

blocks.html: To find a group of 4, count each group and stop at the one that has 4.

blocks.title: Four spoons
blocks.q: Which pile has 4 spoons: the one with 3 or the one with 4?

blocks.html: For the grown-up: Ask for a number of things: “Can you give me 3 crayons?” Counting out a number is harder than counting a pile, so start small, with 1 to 5. Keep screen time short: two or three problems, then play.

items: Try it at home: “Hand me 3 blocks, please.”

sources.name: Head Start Early Learning Outcomes Framework (ELOF), Mathematics Development, preschool goals P-MATH 1 to 10
